verification.note: frontend/e2e-components/app-header.spec.ts:109 guards the only drive-floor assertion with `if (!m.targetName.whole)`, and nothing in the test checks the 'wider than two fifths' precondition named in its title (lines 96-116). The harness folder 'summer' is 'Holiday 25' (fixtures/appHeader.tsx:29) and the count is 1234 (fixtures/appHeader.tsx:19). Budget: the scope row spans grid columns 2-3, which is 375-32-40-12 = 291px. PageHeader.tsx:136 `max-sm:-mr-2` gives back 8px, so 299px. The scope floor is the drive's w-14 (56px, AppHeader.tsx:40), gap-1 (4px) and '· 1,234 videos' (~90px), ~150px in all; then gap-2 (8px). The quiet Target's max-content is px-2 + 14 + gap-1 + text + gap-1 + 14 (ToolbarMenu.tsx:214-226). The R-5 record measured 120.9px for 'Holiday 25' (decisions.md:57,61), giving ~279px < 299. So the name fits whole and the guarded assertion is skipped. The R-5 app run, with a long drive, also shows 'Holiday 25' whole at 69/69 (decisions.md:57). The exact skip depends on the test machine's fonts, which I could not run, but the margin is about 20px.

The drive span is `min-w-0 truncate max-sm:w-14 max-sm:max-w-max max-sm:grow` (AppHeader.tsx:40). Without `max-sm:grow` it stays at 56px. The scope div still grows (`max-sm:grow max-sm:basis-0`, PageHeader.tsx:123), and `justify-between` (PageHeader.tsx:119) keeps the Target at the end, so the leftover space opens between the count and the Target. The only count-to-Target spacing checks are app-header.spec.ts:140 and :150, and both run only in the longTarget scenarios (lines 118-121). There the Target is cut and the scope is at its min-content floor, so no space would show anyway. The long-drive default test (lines 81-94) and the summer test (96-116) check only drive cut, count/target whole and no overflow, and all of these still pass with a 56px drive. Line 45 checks only `target.left > count.right`. No other spec measures count.right against the Target (grep of frontend for count.right: only app-header.spec.ts:45,140,150 and an unrelated passage-rows spec).

At this commit the scope row is `gap-2` (PageHeader.tsx:119) and the Target wrapper has `max-sm:-mr-2` (PageHeader.tsx:136). decisions.md:141-148 records d4c73ac5 as the fix that narrowed this space from 8 to 4px, and decisions.md:9-10 records ba82c6b7 as putting it back to 8px while hanging the padding into the gutter. The Japanese test (app-header.spec.ts:254-269) checks only the name span's scrollWidth <= clientWidth. So the restored gap is paid for by the hang, as claimed. One correction: compared with the state the reviewer calls '1px short' (gap 8, no hang), the hang adds 8px of room, so the margin is about 7px, not about 4px. I could not read the commit message that quotes '1px short', because no git access was available.
